programme.title: Middle Men
programme.desc: A l'heure des débuts d'Internet, un redoutable businessman lance le premier site pornographique payant.

programme.title: L'ultime sacrifice
programme.desc: Basé sur une histoire vraie, l'aviateur William H. Pitsenbarger reçoit la plus haute distinction militaire.

programme.title: The Big Ugly
programme.desc: Les relations anglo-américaines se détériorent quand des mafieux londoniens investissent en Virginie.

programme.title: Last Survivors
programme.desc: Un père et son fils, rencontrent un étranger qui menace de détruire l'utopie qu'ils ont construite.

programme.title: Apartment 12
programme.desc: Un artiste de Los Angeles voit sa vie basculer lorsque son exposition d'art est annulée et que sa petite-amie mannequin le quitte.

programme.title: Life or Something Like It
programme.desc: Lanie est une journaliste télé ambitieuse, convaincue qu'avoir la plus parfaite des coiffures, le plus beau des amants et le plus luxueux des appartements est ce qui rend véritablement heureux...

programme.title: Love's Kitchen
programme.desc: Rob Haley, chef talentueux de Londres, est en deuil quand il perd sa femme. Avec les encouragements de son célèbre ami et Chef, Gordon Ramsay, Rob se lance un nouveau défi : transformer un vieux pub à la dérive en restaurant gastronomique.

programme.title: Le Livre de l'Amour
programme.desc: Henry et Penny vivent à la Nouvelle-Orléans et forment un couple très amoureux, jusqu'à ce que la tragédie frappe. Henry est alors contraint de se reconstruire. Après s'être lié d'amitié avec une adolescente à la rue revêche, il décide de l'aider à construire un radeau pour traverser l'Atlantique.

programme.title: Un Jour
programme.desc: Emma et Dexter passent la nuit ensemble après leur soirée de fin d'étude et décident…de rester amis.

programme.title: Le carrefour du parc
programme.desc: "Il est midi dans un parc isolé au pied des collines de Los Angeles. April est venue pour se suicider Krysta et Dennis s'échangent des tendresses dans sa voiture tandis que son collègue Ian attend dans une camionnette de lavage pour chiens Peg, l'épouse de Dennis, et sa meilleure amie Claire les ont suivis et prévoient une guérilla amoureuse et quatre jeunes trentenaires du même bureau discutent dans une autre camionnette. April demande de l'aide à Ian (du lubrifiant, un tuyau, un briquet), qui lui demande s'il peut l'accompagner. Claire et Peg piègent les amants dans la voiture de Dennis puis ont une conversation intime. Nathan et Babar avouent à Meredith et Cheryl qu'ils sont nudistes, tandis que Meredith insiste pour dire que les deux hommes sont gays. Les vêtements tombent et les vérités éclatent. Est-ce juste une journée de plus à Los Angeles ?"

programme.title: Les Babysitters
programme.desc: À 17 ans, Shirley Lyner, lycéenne, pense à l'université et gère un service de baby-sitting qui fournit des call-girls adolescentes aux pères de jeunes enfants. Dans un long flashback, nous voyons ce qui l'a amenée à passer du statut de baby-sitter à celui d'organisatrice et de gérante du service. Tout commence avec Michael, le père des enfants dont elle s'occupe. Une tasse de café sur le chemin du retour, une visite nocturne dans une gare de triage, et les choses s'enchaînent. Shirley peut se montrer impitoyable, et la tension monte lorsque certains clients emmènent les filles dans un chalet à la montagne et apportent de la drogue. Puis, l'une des filles tente de se mettre à son compte. Cela peut-il bien se terminer : est-ce une tragédie en devenir ? Avons-nous tous des secrets ?

programme.title: La montagne du silence
programme.desc: Les deux amies Johanna et Marlies sont spécialisées dans la conception de campagnes de marketing au sein de l'Association autrichienne du tourisme. Lorsqu'on a demandé à Johanna de commercialiser une région montagneuse isolée de Styrie en tant que nouvelle "destination de plaisir", son enthousiasme était limité. La citadine invétérée ne peut rien faire avec les montagnes, les fermes et les cloches qui sonnent. Son amie et collègue Marlies, en revanche, aime les montagnes par-dessus tout et est donc en feu lorsqu'elle se voit attribuer le contrat pour le projet sur la recommandation de Johanna. Elle parvient même à convaincre l'alpiniste de renommée mondiale Ferdinand Plocher de participer à la campagne - et elle s'intéresse aussi personnellement à ce charmant homme de plein air. Tout semble être parfait : Johanna peut rester à Vienne pendant que les Marlies, pleines de vie, se baladent dans les montagnes pour faire des recherches. Jusqu'à ce que Johanna reçoive la nouvelle choquante de la mort de son ami. Stupéfaite et accablée par un profond sentiment de culpabilité, elle se rend en Styrie pour ramener le corps de Marlies à la maison. Elle y retrouve Ferdinand, qui avait flirté sans retenue avec elle lors de sa visite à Vienne, mais qui se retrouve soudain à l'écart. Comme Marlies auparavant, Johanna loue une chambre d'hôte sur l'Almhof au frère de Ferdinand, Jörg, un solitaire amer qui doit s'occuper seul de sa fille malade Veverl. Les querelles constantes entre les frères différents rendent Johanna méfiante. D'autres éléments indiquent également que l'accident d'escalade de Marlies s'est produit différemment de ce qui avait été annoncé. Bien qu'elle rencontre un mur de silence parmi les villageois, elle continue à faire des recherches inlassables. Et même si Ferdinand ne l'aide pas vraiment, les deux se rapprochent émotionnellement. Plus Johanna passe de temps avec l'alpiniste passionné, plus elle apprend à apprécier les montagnes majestueuses et impressionnantes. Elle commence alors à tomber amoureuse de l'homme qui semble le mieux connaître les véritables circonstances de la mort de son amie.

programme.title: Un hiver à Central Park
programme.desc: L'histoire d'une femme confrontée à la mort de sa fille en bas âge, tout en essayant de préserver son mariage et sa relation avec son beau-fils.

programme.title: Macbeth
programme.desc: Les bas-fonds de Melbourne, dans un futur proche. Macbeth est le bras droit de Duncan, le parrain local. Selon une prophétie, Duncan, deviendra prochainement un gangster extrêmement puissant, sans rival ni limite. Dévorée d'ambition, la femme de Macbeth tente de le convaincre de tuer Duncan afin de prendre sa place.

programme.title: Pas de Chance
programme.desc: Un réseau tendu et complexe de tromperie et de trahison empêtre Archie, un escroc errant qui est engagé par un propriétaire de carnaval itinérant pour assassiner sa belle épouse.

programme.title: The Road Within
programme.desc: Vincent, atteint du syndrome Gilles de la Tourette, fait la rencontre de Marie et Alex dans une clinique spécialisée. Ce trio atypique s'embarque dans le voyage de sa vie.

programme.title: Kids In America
programme.desc: Un groupe divers d'élèves s'unit pour défier pacifiquement leur principal autoritaire.

programme.title: Roxanne
programme.desc: Dans la petite ville touristique de Nelson, Washington, le sympathique chef des pompiers , C.D. Bales (Steve Martin) est sensible aux remarques sur son nez particulièrement long. Une belle astronome intelligente, Roxanne (Daryl Hannah), en ville pour étudier une comète, est attirée par un autre nouveau-venu, le pompier professionnel travaillant auprès de C.D., Chris (Rick Rossovich).

programme.title: Pixels
programme.desc: Lorsque des extraterrestres débarquent sur notre planète et prennent la forme de PAC MAN, Donkey Kong, Galaga, Centipede et Space Invaders pour nous attaquer, le président Will Cooper (Kevin James) doit faire appel à une équipe un peu particulière pour nous sauver. Sam (Adam Sandler), Ludlow (Josh Gad) et Eddie (Peter Dinklage), experts en jeux d'arcades dans les années 80, vont devoir ensemble faire face à leurs personnages préférés pour sauver la Terre, en comptant sur leur expertise, et sur des armes uniques

programme.title: Little Man
programme.desc: Un jeune homme pressé d'être père confond un jeune garçon qu'il doit adopter avec un criminel en fuite qui a la particularité d'avoir un visage poupin et d'être de petite taille. Mais ce dernier se rend vite compte qu'il vaut mieux avoir les flics aux fesses plutôt que des couches !

programme.title: Les Indians 2
programme.desc: Les Indians doivent retrouver leur esprit d'équipe pour rester champions.

programme.title: Le Chevalier black
programme.desc: Jamal Walker est un employé de Medieval World, un parc à thème vétuste. Il se retrouve soudain projeté dans le passé, au cœur de l'Angleterre du XIVe siècle.

programme.title: Une famille 2 en 1
programme.desc: Veuf, Frank se rend à une réunion d'anciens étudiants et y retrouve Helen, son ex-petite amie, elle aussi restée seule après le décès de son mari. Le courant passe immédiatement et le couple décide rapidement de s'installer ensemble.

programme.title: Very Bad Cops
programme.desc: Les inspecteurs Gamble et Hoitz de la police de New York (Will Ferrell et Mark Wahlberg) sont condamnés à passer leur vie derrière un bureau. Ils se détestent, ainsi que leur boulot monotone et insignifiant, dans l'ombre des deux meilleurs flics de la ville (Samuel L. Jackson et Dwayne Johnson).

programme.title: Braqueurs Amateurs
programme.desc: Dick Harper vient de recevoir une grande promotion : il est nommé vice-président de la communication du groupe Globodyne. Forte de cette bonne nouvelle, son épouse, Jane, démissionne pour ne plus s'occuper que de leur fils et de leur belle maison.

programme.title: Billy le Kid
programme.desc: Tom Carter envoie son fils Billy chercher l'aide du shérif lorsque la ferme est attaquée par les hommes de main du voisin Jon Pryce.

programme.title: Le grand McLintock
programme.desc: George Washington McLintock, "GW" pour les amis comme pour les ennemis, est un baron du bétail et l'homme le plus riche du territoire.

programme.title: Arriva Sabata…
programme.desc: Sabata et Mangosta sont des braqueurs de banque qui, après un cambriolage, se retrouvent, à la suite d'une série d'événements, à faire équipe avec Peter, un employé de banque.

programme.title: Duel au soleil
programme.desc: La belle Pearl Chavez devient la pupille du premier amour de son père décédé et se retrouve déchirée entre deux frères, l'un bon et l'autre mauvais.

programme.title: On l'appelle Trinita
programme.desc: Un tireur paresseux et peu orthodoxe et son frère corpulent et voleur de chevaux défendent une colonie mormone contre un major accapareur de terres, un bandit mexicain et leurs hommes de main.

programme.title: No Name & Dynamite
programme.desc: No Name and Dynamite commence lorsque nous rencontrons le partenariat de chasse aux primes entre No Name (Northup) et Dynamite Davenport (Ting), qui font leur propre chemin pour collecter les primes, mais s'entraident lorsqu'il s'agit des primes les plus difficiles.

programme.title: Un bounty killer à Trinita
programme.desc: Les habitants de Trinity décident d'engager un chasseur de primes notoire pour les protéger d'une bande de hors-la-loi mexicains qui sème la terreur dans la région. Il découvre que le véritable instigateur de ces bandits se cache en ville. Une fusillade sanglante met fin à l'emprise de la bande et rend le contrôle de la ville à ses habitants.

programme.title: Le Vent de la Justice
programme.desc: Dans le Far West anarchique, un jeune homme et son frère sont contraints de partir en voyage pour venger la mort de leur père, protéger la tribu Apache qu'ils ont appris à aimer et récupérer la terre et l'or qui leur appartiennent de droit.

programme.title: Seisme Imminent
programme.desc: Un pirate informatique mécontent utilise le fils rebelle du président d'une grande société de logiciels pour créer Havoc.

programme.title: Two Eyes Staring
programme.desc: Paul, Christine et leur petite fille de 9 ans, Lisa, forment une famille ordinaire. Ils héritent d'une effrayante demeure laissée par la mère de Christine avec laquelle ils n'avaient plus de relations. Peu de temps après avoir emménagé, Lisa a d'étranges visions et se rend compte que sa sinistre nouvelle amie n'est autre que le fantôme de la jumelle morte de sa maman. Le père de Lisa finit lui aussi par suspecter sa femme de cacher un horrible secret, ce qui aura des conséquences mortelles….

programme.title: Mass Murderer
programme.desc: Eva est une jeune femme flic chargée des affaires de vols au sein de la ville de Barcelone. Un jour, elle est appelée en urgence pour rejoindre l'unité qui traque une tueuse en série ayant pour cible les vieilles femmes. Alors qu'un vent de panique s'abat sur la ville, la jeune femme pourtant novice dans ce genre d'affaires, va tenter de mettre la main sur la meurtrière… C'est sans ompter la bataille personnelle qu'elle va devoir mener de front contre son inspecteur en chef, qui passe son temps à lui fermer la porte au nez et lui compliquer la tâche au sein de l'unité.

programme.title: Les Nazis au centre de la terre
programme.desc: Des chercheurs en Antarctique sont enlevés et entraînés sous terre par une équipe de survivants nazis qui planifient la renaissance du Troisième Reich.

programme.title: Ultimate Chabite
programme.desc: Kevin, Antho, Erwan et Rodrigo lancent un chabite, qui ne va jamais s'arrêter. Au départ c'est un simple jeu viral et absurde, mais très vite les complications arrivent. Les accidents se multiplient et les autorités commencent à s'y intéresser, tandis qu'Antho, le plus radical des 4 amis...

programme.title: Enlèvement
programme.desc: À la recherche d'une femme disparue dans le Dakota du Nord, un agent du FBI et un shérif se concentrent sur son mari, un fanatique religieux, mais découvrent quelque chose de bien plus sinistre.

programme.title: Life like
programme.desc: Un jeune couple idéaliste et séduisant acquiert un robot magnifique et réaliste pour une aide gratuite, mais à mesure que les trois se rapprochent, leur perception de l'humanité sera modifiée à jamais.

programme.title: Continental Split
programme.desc: Lorsqu'une faille menace de diviser les États-Unis, une équipe désespérée de sismologues et d'agents gouvernementaux s'efforce d'éviter la catastrophe alors que le temps presse.

programme.title: The Professor and the Madman
programme.desc: Le professeur James Murray commence à recueillir des mots pour la première édition de l'Oxford English Dictionary au milieu du XIXe siècle et reçoit plus de 10 000 mots de la part d'un patient interné dans un hôpital psychiatrique.

programme.title: The book of love
programme.desc: Un architecte tente de tenir une promesse faite à sa défunte épouse en aidant une jeune sans-abri qui rêve de traverser l'océan sur un radeau fait maison.

programme.title: L'amour hors limlite
programme.desc: Un jeune homme revient dans sa ville natale après la mort de son père et retrouve ses deux amis mariés. En restant, il ravive son ancienne attirance pour l'épouse de l'un d'eux, la laissant déchirée entre loyauté et désir.

programme.title: La comtessse
programme.desc: Une comtesse hongroise du XVIIe siècle se lance dans une entreprise meurtrière, convaincue que se baigner dans le sang de vierges préservera sa beauté.

programme.title: Levels
programme.desc: Dans un futur proche, Joe assiste, impuissant, au meurtre de sa compagne Ash, avant que le mystérieux tueur ne disparaisse instantanément. Dévasté, il sombre dans le désespoir, jusqu'à découvrir que la réalité est une illusion..

programme.title: Jack Strong
programme.desc: L'espion polonais le plus spectaculaire de l'époque de la guerre froide, le colonel Ryszard Kuklinski, informe les Américains des plus grands secrets du bloc communiste face à l'imminence de la loi martiale.

programme.title: Justice IA
programme.desc: Une juge qui évalue un logiciel judiciaire basé sur l'IA découvre un meurtre et un complot lorsque son créateur meurt. Elle doit affronter de puissants intérêts étatiques alors que sa vie est en jeu.

programme.title: Clean
programme.desc: Tourmenté par son passé, un éboueur nommé Clean tente une vie tranquille de rédemption, mais se retrouve bientôt obligé de se réconcilier avec la violence de son passé.

programme.title: Les Chiens Enragés
programme.desc: En possession de l'argent volé dans un transport de fonds dont ils éliminent l'un des convoyeurs, quatre braqueurs prennent la fuite devant la police. Commence alors une cavale où, à chaque instant, le pire peut arriver...

programme.title: Maniac
programme.desc: Traumatisé par les mauvais traitements qui lui faisait subir sa mère, Frank hante les rues de New York à la recherche de jeunes femmes dont il prélève le scalp. Sa rencontre avec une jeune photographe lui permettra-t-elle de contenir ses pulsions homicides ?

programme.title: Uberlinks
programme.desc: Claude et Mahalia ont matché sur une application de rencontre pour personnes dotées de super-pouvoirs. Celui de Claude ? Devenir invisible. Quand Mahalia insiste pour connaître sa première action à la découverte de son pouvoir, Claude fait tout pour fuir la question. De peur de ruiner ses chances avec elle.

programme.title: Mantra
programme.desc: Emma et Paul viennent de s'installer dans une banlieue pavillonnaire de province. À peine les cartons défaits, Paul doit aussitôt partir pour un long voyage d'affaires. Dans son bureau, Emma découvre un insecte perché dans un grand vivarium : une mante religieuse. Cette dernière la répugne autant qu'elle la fascine.

programme.title: Totem VF
programme.desc: Buffle, un ancien scout, n'a toujours pas fait le deuil de son ami disparu il y a vingt ans. En plus de cela, il est constamment hanté par un rat géant… Sa psychologue lui conseille de reformer sa bande en organisant un camp. Mais cette thérapie de groupe va prendre une nouvelle dimension lorsque que nos quadragénaires vont découvrir un passage temporel.

programme.title: Les Bouchers verts
programme.desc: Deux amis décident de monter leur propre boucherie afin d'échapper à un patron étouffant, mais la clientèle se fait rare. La chance tourne à la suite d'un malencontreux accident qui permettra à Svend d'offrir, une recette "maison" : une viande à la saveur très originale mais à l'approvisionnement plus que délicat...

programme.title: Totem VF
programme.desc: Buffle, un ancien scout, n'a toujours pas fait le deuil de son ami disparu il y a vingt ans. En plus de cela, il est constamment hanté par un rat géant… Sa psychologue lui conseille de reformer sa bande en organisant un camp. Mais cette thérapie de groupe va prendre une nouvelle dimension lorsque que nos quadragénaires vont découvrir un passage temporel.

programme.title: Abandonnée
programme.desc: Marie hérite en Russie et découvre un double d'elle-même aux yeux vitreux.

programme.title: Ape vs Mecha Ape
programme.desc: L'armée fabrique sa propre I.A. prête au combat : Mecha Ape.

programme.title: Blind Waters
programme.desc: Un requin implacable transforme les vacances de rêve d'un couple en cauchemar lorsqu'ils s'échouent en mer et sont contraints de se battre pour sauver leur vie.

programme.title: Tuer pour Survivre
programme.desc: Un mercenaire tente de se racheter après avoir été l'homme de main impitoyable d'un syndicat.

programme.title: Game of Death
programme.desc: L'agent spécial Marcus Jones est assigné au chevet d'un diplomate victime d'un attentat. Jones s'allie à une infirmière pour mettre hors d'état de nuire les tueurs

programme.title: Mission : Executive Protection
programme.desc: Membre des Forces Spéciales, Max Webber s'est reconverti dans la protection rapprochée de personnalités. Engagé par un homme riche, il se retrouve au coeur d'une conspiration planétaire.

programme.title: Hirokin: Le dernier Samurai
programme.desc: Hirokin, un héros réticent marqué par un sombre passé, doit accomplir son destin lorsqu'il est contraint de choisir entre venger le meurtre de sa famille ou lutter pour la liberté d'un peuple longtemps maltraité.

programme.title: The final run
programme.desc: Pierce Butler, ancien Marine et trafiquant de marijuana à la retraite, doit reprendre ses activités illégales pour un dernier coup afin de sauver sa maison et son entreprise alors que sa femme lutte contre un cancer rare.

programme.title: Hanna
programme.desc: Hanna (SAOIARSE RONAN) a 16 ans. Elle est intelligente, curieuse, jolie - et se révèle être un assassin professionnel. Ayant passé presque toute sa vie dans la toundra à apprendre des techniques de combat enseignées par son père (ERIC BANA), elle revient à la civilisation où un agent sans scrupules de la CIA (CATE BLANCHETT) tente de la faire disparaître. Tout en apprenant comment elle est devenue une machine à tuer, Hanna doit se battre pour survivre et finalement, éliminer la personne qui est responsable de ce qu'elle est devenue.

programme.title: Crazy Kung Fu
programme.desc: Sing, un prétendu gangster, doit surmonter son incapacité à manier le sabre et démontrer qu'il a toutes les qualités requises pour appartenir au prestigieux gang de Axe. Dans le même temps, ce gang veut régner en maître sur le territoire le plus convoité qui est en fait une rue sacrée protégée par une bande de personnages hauts en couleurs.

programme.title: Le Maitre Chinois
programme.desc: Le jeune Wong Fei-Hong, enfant indiscipliné, est envoyé apprendre le Kung Fu chez son oncle au caractère très autoritaire. Seule une terrible menace pesant sur son père l'amène à rentrer chez lui.

programme.title: Searching
programme.desc: Alors que Margot, 16 ans, a disparu, l'enquête ouverte ne donne rien et malgré les heures décisives qui s'écoulent, l'inspectrice chargée de l'affaire n'a pas le moindre indice. Le père, David (John Cho), décide alors de mener ses propres recherches, en commençant par là où personne n'a encore regardé : l'ordinateur de sa fille. Dans un thriller hyper moderne tourné uniquement à travers des appareils technologiques que l'on utilise quotidiennement pour communiquer, David doit impérativement retrouver la trace de sa fille avant qu'elle ne disparaisse pour toujours.

programme.title: Le Combattant
programme.desc: Jem Belcher est né dans la pauvreté, élevé par son grand-père, un ancien boxeur. Désespérant de gagner sa vie et d'honorer l'héritage de son grand-père, il cherche un mentor auprès d'un entraîneur renommé, qui l'entraîne à devenir le plus grand combattant du monde. Inspiré d'une histoire vraie.

programme.title: Charlie Countryman
programme.desc: Complètement déboussolé après le décès de sa mère, Charlie décide de suivre son instinct et de partir pour Bucarest. Dans cette ville survoltée, il tombe amoureux de la très énigmatique Gabi.

programme.title: Storm Boy
programme.desc: Storm Boy a bien grandi pour devenir un retraité respecté au caractère bien trempé. Son quotidien est brusquement perturbé par des images tirées de son passé qu'il n'arrive pas à décrypter. Une conversation avec sa petite fille le replonge dans une enfance qu'il pensait enfouie à tout jamais.

programme.title: Layer Cake
programme.desc: Un dealer de cocaïne respecté au sein de l'élite de la mafia anglaise décide de prendre sa retraite. Jimmy Price, un gros caïd, lui demande cependant une dernière faveur: retrouver Charlotte, la fille portée disparue de l'un de ses vieux amis.

programme.title: Lamborghini : L'homme derrière la légende
programme.desc: Adapté du livre de son fils Tonino, le film retrace la vie de Ferruccio Lamborghini, le célèbre créateur de la marque automobile éponyme.

programme.desc: Après la mort de sa femme, un garde du corps professionnel est parti à l'étranger pour trouver des médecins pour sa fille, mais a plutôt trouvé un nouvel emploi en tant que testeur de réalité virtuelle.

programme.title: The Package (Killers game)
programme.desc: Un coursier pour un seigneur du crime local doit livrer un mystérieux paquet tout en étant poursuivi par une horde de gangsters peu ordinaires.

programme.title: Signs of Evil
programme.desc: The symbol of the SS, Hitler's Schutzstaffel, stands for terror and the murder of millions. The penniless graphic artist Walter Heck was given the job of designing the jagged, rune-like characters in 1929. The “sig” rune was rooted deep in the ideological cosmos of the Nazis and their supporters. They saw themselves as the descendants of the Teutons and declared the runes to be humanity's original Germanic script. The symbol was meant to unite Heinrich Himmler's “Black Order.” But did it escape their notice that it was originally of Semitic origin? In October 1945, the Allies passed a law banning the Nazi Party and all associated organizations, including the SS. The young Federal Republic even forbade all Nazi symbols. This documentary tells the gripping story of the SS symbol, from the Middle Ages to the present day.

programme.title: Hidden Japan
programme.desc: Japan is the fourth largest island nation in the world and the second most populous. The culture of Japan is incredible, but even this is overshadowed by nature's beauty. There are more than 130 mammals and an astonishing 600 bird species dwelling in Japan's 6,852 islands. This island chain is so long that it spans several climate zones, providing a huge range of habitat for wildlife. Look beyond the ancient temples and glass skyscrapers and volcanos loom, bears hunt and birds do battle. This is the hidden Japan.

programme.title: Menorca
programme.desc: Not nearly as crowded as Majorca or Ibiza: Menorca has noticeably fewer visitors than her sister islands and in 1993, was recognised by UNESCO as a biosphere re-serve. Menorca also has its own distinctive charm, with its secluded coves, mighty cliffs, beautiful gardens and ages old towns and villages. Its residents love the is-lands treasures and peculiarities. Forests make up al-most a third of Menorca, complemented by many lush green meadows. Next to tourism, agriculture is a major source of the island's income to the present day. On Menorca, there are several accumulations of enormous megalithic stones. From a global point of view, the up to five-metre-tall "Taulas", whereby the stones are ar-ranged in the shape of a "T", are unique.

programme.title: mareTV
programme.desc: The light of the Balearic island of Ibiza is magical and its trademark: The "Island of Light" is tiny compared to its sister island Mallorca, but offers the most beautiful sunsets in the world. That's what they say. They attract sun worshippers and party people from near and far. To the sounds of the famous "Balearic Sound" they turn night into day. This documentary documents the island in the balancing act between luxury yachts and traditions. Hippie culture, celebrities, pine forests, bays with turquoise water and villages with bright white houses: Ibiza has many faces. Mora (80) and Djin (67) have been drawn to the island for 55 years. They are the uncrowned kings of the hippies. But only love, light, air and laziness, these times are also long gone on Ibiza. Mora knits sexy jerseys for young hippies from morning till night. Djin helps her sell at the famous Las Dalias hippie market and works as a construction worker: chilling and no pension in sight. The virgin Carmen is the patron saint of the sailors. On her day of honour, a mass is celebrated in the port city of Eivissa. Afterwards, fishermen carry the Virgin through the narrow streets of Ibiza City down to the quay. And then Carmen sets sail. Several places on Ibiza claim to offer the most beautiful sunset in the world: In front of Cala de Benirrás, the sun sinks right next to the iconic rock Cap Benat, which the locals awefully call "God's Finger". The typical soft beats over the sea sound from almost all the bays and provide deep relaxation worldwide under the term "Balearic Sound". Some of the famous DJs are jetting around the globe for huge fees. But in the small beach bars, the Chiringuitos, the island sound is celebrated further. On the beach of Cala Salada the Brit Joe Burnley has the command over a troop of mermaids. The ladies squeeze into the tight mermaid costume for the good cause. With great grace they swim towards yachts that are forbidden to anchor on sea grass meadows. Charming but unyielding, they point out the offence to the captain and crew a creative environmental action to save the endangered Neptune gas, green lung of the sea and habitat for Ibiza's seahorses. The underwater photographer Manu San Felix is also committed to the endangered seahorses. Using a probe, he maps the coastal area around Ibiza and feeds the data into a GPS app. No skipper should be able to say that he didn't even know that his anchor was clawing into Neptune grass. On land, Manu is dedicated to breeding seahorses. His plan: He wants to expose the animals in the Mediterranean to Ibiza and Formentera in order to secure their population. Garages on the beach? Many bays on the island still have Casetas Varadero, boat garages threatened with decay. Fishermen once built them illegally. The picturesque sheds are therefore only tolerated, but may no longer be restored. The 83-year-old Toni Salvado still drives straight out to sea from his garage. programme.title: Fuerteventura: The golden beauty of the Canaries
programme.desc: Fuerteventura, the second largest of the Canary Islands, is located just 120 kilometres off the coast of West Africa. The climate is extremely dry and the struggle for water has always been a major setback. Then, around a century ago, returning US emigrants brought what were then modern wind turbine water pumps from the Aermotor Windmill Company with them to Fuerte-ventura. Today, the environmentally friendly and so-called “Chicago's”, experience a renaissance. Unfortu-nately, original spare parts in good condition are diffi-cult to come by. When Leocadio Araya Sanchez began planting countless cacti on a barren hillside a few years ago, people thought he was mad. His idea was to make a healthy juice drink from the prickly pears – with great success. But getting the fruit to release its pre-cious superfood juice is no simple task. On an almost daily basis, Marcos Tapia is magnetically attracted to one of the paradisiacal beaches of the island. The 44-year-old is Spanish champion and vice world champion in para-body board surfing. When he was 28. Marcos was involved in a serious motorbike accident and has been paraplegic ever since.

programme.title: Mysterious Oceanic Oases
programme.desc: Countless marine animals frolic on the steep slopes of underwater volcanoes. In many cases, several are rare species not found elsewhere. This is in part due to the fact that plankton clings to the wall and provides the fish with food in abundance. This documentary shows several of these oases and also examines the impact dive tourism has and whether preventive measures can help to maintain them. Nature and underwater filmmaker Rolf Möltgen undertakes dives into the mysterious underwater mountain landscapes with marine scientists from all corners of the globe. This journey takes us to Mexico, to snappers, white-tip reef sharks, Galapagos sharks and giant mantas. We visit the Maldives, Colombia and Costa Rica, where the team documents rare species such as deep sea burbots, small tooth sand tiger and dogfish sharks, in depths of more than 3 metres. The eerie underwater mountain world proves: everyone plays a part in the network of life. Thanks to consistent protective regulations, it has been possible to retain the underwater diversity - especially in the unique oases of the high seas

programme.title: Wild Serbia
programme.desc: Serbia is in the heart of the Balkans, a “little Europe“ within Europe with its rich variety of landscapes and natural beauties, it certainly does this name justice. This nature documentary presents Serbia's breath-taking, picturesque regions and unique wildlife on a journey to the most beautiful and wildest areas of the Balkan peninsula, from high mountains across gentle hills to the vast plains of the Puszta. Serbia is only about five times the size of Schleswig Holstein, yet here the most varied vegetation zones, animal kingdoms and cultures meet. And even today a large number of Serbian people live in close communion with nature. They are proud of the storks' nests in the villages, the ancient species of livestock that have been preserved and the vultures that return to make their home here. In many places people are pleased to see bears, lynx and wolves, and even jackals are at home in the forests of Siberia. It is a country full of traditions and folklore, with deep influences from the Orient as well as the West. The Danube is the most prominent river in Serbia. As it makes its way through the Carpathian Mountains of Rumania it forms the most imposing gorge in Europe, the Iron Gates. Other striking features of Serbia's landscape include the archaic earth pyramids of Devil's Town, towering up in powerful red colours - and what must be the driest region of Siberia, the Deliblatska Pescara, which is also known as Europe's Sahara. Colourful birds called bee-eaters have settled on a rocky slope - a whole, noisy colony of them. They make their nests in caves which they dig themselves in the ground, and the inaccessible location means it is difficult for enemies to reach them. The more frequently the male brings the female insects it has caught, the more powerful is the bond between them later.

programme.title: Amazing Iran
programme.desc: For the Iranian Turkmen a wedding is one of most important social events in their culture and is still celebrated according to old nomadic tradition. The Turkmen Steppe, the country of a thousand mountains, is a tribute to the hidden treasure that is Iran. Home to a proud nation with a majestic history, we show the freedom of a nomadic life, encounter the wild nature of the people and discover old traditions like the Turkmen wedding. Breathtaking sceneries create a mysticism that transports viewers into the realm of divinity while exposing a world caught between tradition and modernity - nomadism and sedentarism. Weddings in Iran are primarily arrangements between families and the product of lengthy negotiations. Even though many customs are purely symbolic, they still reflect the great significance as a rite of transition for the newlyweds and their families. The life of the Turkmen housewife revolves around weddings – first her own, later those of her children. Raising healthy, capable daughters and sons searching for possible partners mediating contact negotiating each betrothal with the family of the intended shouldering the wedding arrangements and the observance of customs and traditions – the responsibility for all of that falls to the mother. Though the Turkmen daughters and sons of today do insist on having their say, love, affection, trust and the like are still not the decisive criteria in making a match. The main consideration is not the subjective happiness of the couple but the happiness, stability and honor of each of their families as a whole. So it is still not uncommon for the bride and groom to be virtual strangers on their wedding day. The nuptials as a ritual of transition mark a series of profound changes – especially in the life of the bride. Once married, she leaves her family and her home village to take her new place within the family of the groom.

programme.title: Amazing Isfahan
programme.sub-title: Paradise in the Heart of Iran
programme.desc: Take a look at this natural beauty. Isfahan – the Florence of Persia, the blue pearl of Iran. The city in the heart of Iran is the most charismatic city in the country and often uttered in the same breath as Bagdad, Constantinople or Cairo. The former capital of the Persian Safavid Empire has long since lost the status of cosmopolitan city, but it still radiates a cosmopolitan charm of which the inhabitants are extremely proud. With its Iranian and Persian national consciousness, Isfahan emits a form of comeliness that attracts people near and far. Following the 30-year-old carpet dealer Shanty as he tries to establish a business for himself and his fiancée Nina, we discover the soul of the city with mesmeric shots, intimate portraits and true to life portrayals of daily life. For 120 years his family has been dealing with noble Persian carpets, but Shanty dreams of a modern coffee shop, driven by a youthful eagerness to experiment and with passion for the new. In the cozy little espresso bar on the city's famous Imam Square Shanty's barista conjures up the best créma in Isfahan while Pink Floyd, The Grateful Death and Led Zeppelin boom from the loudspeakers nothing new in Berlin or Paris but almost revolutionary here. In intimate pictures, we accompany the youngest son of an old Isfahan family through his bulging everyday life and see how many young Iranians try to unite the culture and traditions of their country with the present.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Two little devilish girls are coming visiting Jon. They really want to play dolls with Garfield and Odie, who only want to stay clear from them.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Garfield is stuck in a parallel world where cats have taken the place of humans, and vice versa!

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Jon sends Garfield to Dr Whipple's Show in order for him to learn how to be a well-behaved cat.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Garfield accidentally climbs into an outer space traveller's car, which sends him into parallel worlds.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Sir Leo, a famous TV Actor, looks very much like Garfield. So when he has to go on vacations, Garfield takes his place and gets to taste celebrity and glitter.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Our heroes are on a fishing trip. Odie saves a little fish and goes to explore the underwater world with Garfield.

programme.title: The Good, The Bad And The Tightwad
programme.desc: Clay wakes up in the poor town of Nothing Hill which literally have nothing. Will Clay remember who he is and what he is fighting for. His friends try to help him, but Jorah Tightwad and his Bots get in the way. Clay as the Gray Knight wakes up far away in a place called Nothing Hill. A poor town where they literally have nothing. They harvest dust. Jorah Tightwad though has found that there is gold underneath the town. He convinces the confused Clay to help him put pressure on the poor townsfolk to give up their lots. This is an easy job for the strong Gray Knight. The NEXO KNIGHTS finally track him down and tries to convince him about who he is. But to the Gray Knight they are still his enemies, and a giant battle ensues in order to subdue the Gray Knight. At last, only Macy is left. When she begins to recite the Knights Code, some words and their meaning are able to get through the stone hard shell of the Gray Knight and the Evil that clouded him seems to disappear. Together they are able to return the ownership of the town to the villagers.

programme.title: The Book Of Monsters, Part 1
programme.desc: When Jestro the Jester finds the Book of Monsters, chaos breaks loose in the Kingdom of Knighton. Can the newly graduated Knights from the Knights' Academy save the kingdom? It's final graduation fighting exams for the latest Knights from Knights' Academy. All our new Knights demonstrate their prowess: CLAY, AARON, AXL and LANCE. PRINCESS MACY get to join them, but her father doesn't want her to graduate. As part of the entertainment, MERLOK does an amazing magic trick. His act is followed by…JESTRO, the King's Jester. He's terrible (and he should know to never follow a better act.) Everyone laughed because he's a real joke....a total failure. While Jestro roams the halls fo the King's Castle, forlorn, he hears the BOOK OF MONSTERS calling to him from Merlok's library. The book talks Jestro into gathering as many books of spells as he can carry, but they're interrupted by...Clay! As Jestro quickly pages through the Book of Monsters to attack Clay, Merlok arrives. There's a battle in the library between Jestro and Merlok. Finally, the wizard summons up his most powerful spell in self-defence. BOOM! There's a big, magical explosion and when Clay forces his way back into the library, Merlok, Jestro and the magic books are...GONE!

programme.title: The Book Of Monsters, Part 2
programme.desc: Realizing they must defend the Kingdom from Jestro's monsters, the Knights try to organize but are despondent when they discover their best advisor – Merlok the Magician – has sacrificed himself to save them. When Jestro awakens, he's been blasted miles and miles away from the King's Castle by Merlok's explosive spell. And, it seems, all the books he was trying to steal have been scattered, too. The Book of Monsters broke Jestro' fall and now he can use the book to attack the people who laughed at him. Meanwhile, the King and his newly-trained Knights pick through the rubble of Merlok's library. They'll have to figure something out, because Jestro and his newly made magic monsters attack King's Castle! Clay organizes the Knights to defend the kingdom, but they've never worked together before. It takes all their training, plus the help of an old friend…MERLOK! Only now he's MERLOK 2.0. Ava has been piecing together what happened and discovering that the “ghost in the machine” she's been chasing is really Merlok in digital form. Now, he can use his magic digitally and he downloads just the right weapons to the struggling Knights! They finally foil Jestro's attack with Merlok's help and officially become NEXO KNIGHTS!

programme.title: Chased Dreamers
programme.desc: To craft their own hourglasses and become official Dream Chasers for the Night Bureau, Mateo and his friends must defeat the Dream Forge guardian.

programme.title: The Dream Forge
programme.desc: As time runs out to face the Dream Forge and become official Dream Chasers, Mateo and his friends enlist the help of the mysterious Dream Bandit.

programme.title: Legendary Places, Ninjago's Most Wanted
programme.desc: Cole joins Jay and Zane inside the Nindroid to solve a mysterious puzzle and also Kai enters Zane's mind and suggests the Ninja take a break from puzzle-solving to figure out which villain is trying to hack their friend.

programme.title: The Jade Princess
programme.desc: In the wake of an assassination attempt targeting the royal family, the ninja invite the royal princess, HARUMI, into their makeshift family. Lloyd glimpses someone escaping over the rooftops with a sack on their back. Fearing it is the kidnapped princess, Lloyd takes up the chase! He discovers to his surprise, however, that the masked intruder is none other than the princess herself, who is not quite as docile or meek as she pretends. She has a habit of sneaking out of her chambers at night to feed the homeless who surround the Imperial Palace. This revelation only endears her to Lloyd more and Harumi and Lloyd quickly strike up a friendship. Unfortunately, trouble catches up to the ninja when the Sons Of Garmadon target the second Oni mask and attack the palace. The scope of the attack proves more than the Ninja were prepared for as the Sons of Garmadon detonate a series of subterranean bombs, bringing down part of the palace. Lloyd and Harumi escape onto the flying ship, DESTINY'S BOUNTY. But the victory is a pyrrhic one. The second Oni Mask has been stolen and Harumi's parents and Master Hutchins are feared lost.

programme.title: The Pranks
programme.desc: The friends are using their talents to pull a prank on Olivia. But who gets the last laugh? Stephanie finds the perfect front page story for the school paper! It's almost too good to be true. Emma and Andrea go undercover to solve the mystery of the two Jacobs.

programme.title: Girls on Mission
programme.desc: Andrea relaxes at the beach while Emma is hard at work at her lifeguard tower. Stephanie has to face her fears when the class gets an 'Animal Kingdom & 'school assignment.'Things are getting mixed up on Andrea's first day on the job at Heartlake City Juicebar. Olivia tapes a science show, with a little help from Mia's lemonade stand - and special effects! Emma and Stephanie accidentally rent a scary movie and suddenly there are beasts everywhere... Mia and Stephanie have to use a little horse power at the Sunshine Ranch.

programme.title: The Hands Of Time
programme.desc: Master Wu mistakenly tries to single-handedly complete a battle he began decades ago against Acronix, one of the twin Hands of Time. But the arrival of the first Time Blade – a weapon with the power to speed up time – sends the Ninja to the Monastery just in time to rescue their master from certain doom.

programme.title: The Hatching
programme.desc: The Ninja learn more about the Krux and Acronix – the two fallen Elemental Masters known as the Hands of Time – and are sure that this threat has finally been eliminated. But with Wu out of action and suffering from the effects of the Time Punch, the Ninja discover a new enemy in their midst: The Vermillion Warriors. And the Ninjas have no idea who controls them...

programme.title: A Time Of Traitors
programme.desc: Kai's investigation of a Vermillion Warrior Helmet leads him to discover that Krux is alive and well in Ninjago, living under an assumed identity. Meanwhile, as the Vermillion Warriors go on a kidnapping spree, Lloyd struggles with his role as master-in-training and Nya does her best to reboot Zane, who was knocked off line in his first battle with the Vermillion.

programme.title: The Mask Of Deception
programme.desc: When an unknown criminal syndicate threatens the Royal Family, the Ninja are called back into action and must protect the royal princess and a fabled artifact that may hold supernatural powers. The ninja find themselves scattered to the four corners of the kingdom. Cole and Jay are searching in vain for some sign of Master Wu. Nya fights injustice in the north, while Kai and Zane attempt to fend off an angry lava beast in the west. This leaves Lloyd alone in Ninjago City. He rushes to the scene of a heist at Borg Tower and finds himself up against a team of highly trained operatives led by the mysterious masked MISTER-E. Lloyd fails to prevent the heist and an ancient artifact, the MASK OF DECEPTION, is stolen. Lloyd apprehends one of the criminals but the others escape. Dismayed by his failure, Lloyd calls the ninjas back to Ninjago. The friends are reunited and hope for a little rest and relaxation. These hopes are dashed with the arrival MASTER HUTCHINS, a servant of the Royal Family of Ninjago, who has been sent by the EMPEROR to request their help. A new criminal gang, SONS OF GARMADON (SOG), is attempting to acquire three ancient masks called the ONI MASKS, which are rumored to possess supernatural powers.

programme.title: The Gray Knight
programme.desc: Using his Stone to Life magic the Cloud of Monstrox turns Clay into a living, fighting, breathing stone fighting knight. But will Clay use his forces to fight for good or for evil? Does he have a choice? The Cloud of Monstrox and Jestro are able to unlock the forbidden Power Shocking Scare and unleash an attack on the village of Bravington. Knights in their new vehicles rush to the rescue and are able to defeat him with a new Combo Power. In the heat of the battle, the Cloud of Monstrox sees the stone statue of Clay and zaps him to life! Clay is now turned, and is fighting against his friends. It is impossible for them to defeat him without destroying him for good. The Cloud urges Clay on. He attacks the Fortrex in order to get to Merlok. Robin in his Black Knight Mech is trying to stop him, but to no avail. Merlok 2.0 is left undefended. At the very last moment Merlok 2.0 unleashes a blasting spell that sends Clay far far away.

programme.title: Tailor's Magic Needle
programme.desc: Tailor Smurf has to make an outfit for every Smurf before the Fall fashion show. Brainy Smurf wants to help him and, using Papa Smurf's book of Magic, he conjures up a magic needle that sews ten times faster than tailor... But is it really any good?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Memory Melon: Selwyn and Tallulah are two powerful married wizards. The trouble is, they fight all the time. But the energy from their arguments is brewing up a dreadful storm and Papa has to get them to make up before the storm starts to rage.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - A Smurf For Denisa: Balthazar brings Denisa to Gargamel to baby-sit. But Gargamel loses Denisa in the wood and she and Sassette meet and become friends. Sassette and Denisa work together to free the Smurfs from Gargamel's stewpot, and prove you don't have to be big to be brave.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Peewit's Unscrupulous Adventure: Peewit, the court jester, is the Smurfs' human friend. There is to be a celebration at the King's castle and Peewit good-humouredly invites his little blue friends to the feast. But they learn that the wicked chamberlain is pilfering the King's possessions.

programme.title: The Smurfiest Of Friends
programme.desc: Brainy Smurf had one friend: Clumsy Smurf. But poor Clumsy is so, well, clumsy, that Brainy refuses to see him again. So now he is left without anyone willing to listen to him. Maybe Buddy, the good-looking imp met by chance near the Great Oak can be a pal for Brainy....

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Poltersmurf: There are few things Grandpa Smurf enjoys more than telling a good scary story, and there are few Smurfs who don't love to listen. But things get a little too much for Brainy Smurf when Grandpa tells of Poltersmurfs, and Poltersmurfs begin harrowing Brainy...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Greedy And The Porridge Pot: The good fairy, Guinilda gives Greedy a magic porridge pot that Brainy causes to overflow into the village and forest. The good-hearted fairy hurries to the rescue and then asks for the pot back to give to an orphanage of hungry children.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Most Unsmurfy Games: To prove the worth of his Big Book of Wilderness Survival, Brainy takes the Smurflings to the swamp. Where, thanks to his expert advice, the tiny group gets totally lost, is then caught in quicklime and trapped by King Bullrush of the Wartmongers. Fortunately, Bullrush is in a playful mood and devises a Smurf hunt. Unfortunately, Brainy believes he is a born leader...

programme.title: Smurf Box Derby
programme.desc: Handy Smurf makes another invention: the Smurfmobile. Each Smurf has his – or her – customized vehicle and all, or almost all, the Smurfs enjoy a little spin... But then the evil wizard Gargamel gets hold of the idea and starts making trouble for the Smurfs...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Noble Stag: His wicked cousin, Malcolm the Mean, who plans to kill him and mount him in his trophy room, has turned King Gerard into a black stag. The little Smurfs help their friend. When King Gerard is transformed back into his human form, Malcolm becomes imprisoned in the body of the stag.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Curried Smurfs: In Ancient India, the unscrupulous fakir Gargapuri sells the Smurfs to the Rajah for his private zoo. Only Grandpa, Wild Smurf and Jokey are free, so it's up to them to sneak into the palace and rescue their friends. Along the way they free all the caged animals in the Raja's menagerie.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Hopping Cough Smurfs: The evil wizard Gargamel spreads the forest with the germs of the uncontrollable hopping cough. Baby Smurf is the first victim and all the Village of the Smurfs goes frantic with worry... Fortunately, Papa Smurf thinks there might be a cure.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Sorcerer Smurf: Gargamel creates the legend of Sorcerer Smurf to lure Papa Smurf and his smurfy friends into a trap at his mountain hideaway. Papa Smurf outwits the wicked wizard with some of his own magic and Gargamel is chased down the mountain and back to his castle.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Smurf Who Would Be King: Dreamy yearns to be King after reading a story about them. He falls through a whirlpool while on his ship and finds himself in the land of pokies who think Dreamy is their long-lost King. When he confronts the pokies' enemies, the Norfnags, he finds they aren't fearful at all. Dreamy bumps his head and wakes up to discover it was just a dream, yet finds a jewel in his cap, just like the ones the pokies mine for a living.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - April Smurf's Day: April Smurf's Day turns out to be not so funny when Gargamel dons a smurfberry bush disguise to capture the happy little Smurfs. Papa Smurf instructs Feathers to call the birds to attack the fake bush. After it is stripped, the captured Smurfs climb aboard Feathers and fly away.

programme.title: Beauty Is Only Smurf Deep
programme.desc: Periwinkle, a vain Pixie, is upset when her magic mirror tells her that Vanity is the fairest, not she. Periwinkle kidnaps Vanity, but the rest of the Smurfs come to Vanity's rescue. Periwinkle sees the error of her ways and they become friends.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Never Smurf Off Till Tomorrow: A fierce wind carries the Smurfs' windmill away, with several Smurfs inside. Is Lazy Smurf really at fault or is an injustice being committed? Are the captive Smurfs going to be saved from the volcano's crater? Is Brainy going to smurf up his mouth for a moment?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Soothsayer Smurfette: When Smurfette meets this gentle old gypsy woman in the forest and receives a swirling multicoloured dress, she's delighted. How could she know that this woman is really the evil wizard Gargamel in disguise, and that there is a terrible spell on the beautiful dress?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Lost City Of Yore: Curiosity brings Nosey Smurf to the lair of the Hag Sisters, who want to find the terrifying Sceptre of Yore... And Gargamel wants to cheat the two witches as he tries to destroy the Smurfs.

programme.title: S1 Bwah‑Beats
programme.desc: Music, noise and DJ disasters collide in a rhythm‑fuelled Rabbid mess.

programme.title: Rabbids
programme.desc: The Rabbids wiggle, stumble and go wild in a hilariously chaotic musical mess.

programme.title: New Year Bwah‑nanza
programme.desc: Fireworks, celebrations and lucky chaos burst into action as Rabbids ring in a new year their way.

programme.title: S1 Bwah‑ginnings
programme.desc: The Rabbids unleash their very first wave of chaos, kicking off nonstop mischief.

programme.title: S1 Bwah‑ginnings
programme.desc: The Rabbids unleash their very first wave of chaos, kicking off nonstop mischief.

programme.title: Rabbids
programme.desc: The Rabbids glitch, mash and break their way through game‑style challenges and digital‑feeling chaos.

programme.title: Springtime Scramble & Egg‑Capers
programme.desc: The Rabbids hunt for Easter eggs with spectacularly ridiculous and messy results.

programme.title: Quartet Plus
programme.desc: To play in a quartet is not so easy as it seems, especially if there is no slack between musicians. This is what Masha tells Papa Bear, who came to visit. And he will tell about Bear's childhood and how he was mischievous with the Himalayan bear. Has anything changed since then? We will learn it from the new episode. And most importantly, music will unite everyone!

programme.title: Tour de Forest
programme.desc: Himalayan Bear is once again competing with Bear! This time they have arranged a bike race, but something doesn't smell right: Himalayan Bear intends on cheating to win! Good thing Masha stands as a guardian of justice and always comes to a friend's aid!

programme.title: What's Inside?
programme.desc: "What is inside such seemingly simple objects surrounding us? How are the mechanisms that we use every day arranged? Maybe they work with the help of magic? Or maybe each system has a certain order?In this episode, Masha decides to figure out how the objects surrounding her are arranged. And in the company of an old friend, this research becomes an adventure. "

programme.title: Try, Try Again
programme.desc: A van with Monkeys arrived at the Bear's house. They invite everyone to test themselves with the help of an attraction - a power meter. The Bear is confident that he will easily win the main prize. But things didn't go according to plan. And now the main strongman of the forest cannot do without the help of his friends.

programme.title: Princess and the Beast
programme.desc: Shocking and sensation! For the first time in our forest! A couple of tourists broke into the Bear's house without an invitation in search of impressions and cool photos. And there they are - just a sleepy Bear and Masha, who really wants to play. Rejoice tourists! You will have impressions, photos, and obstacle course from here and to the city itself!

programme.title: First Day Of School
programme.desc: With the beginning of September, Masha, like all the children wants to go to school and asks the Bear to make her one. Overwhelmed with enthu-siasm, the Bear completes the task and the next day Masha sits at a brand new desk and tries to act as an attentive student but ends up bringing the Bear to absolute madness.

programme.title: Fishy story
programme.desc: Summer is a time of rest and miracles. How nice is just to sit on the river bank with your best friends! However, everything is not so simple in our story. The Bear didn't even suspect what kind of adventure he was going to find on his fishing trip. While Masha and She-Bear frightened by his sudden disappearance, explore the neighborhood, he ... however, you will find out everything yourself in our new episode.

programme.title: Don't Wake Till Spring!
programme.desc: The autumn has arrived. The Bear prepares for his winter bedtime by barricading himself from Masha inside the house. But the little girl manages to find her way indoors and causes yet another mess by awakening a whole swarm of bees. But all her games eventually stop and when the Bear cooks some porridge to feed the child, he discovers her fallen asleep.

programme.title: A Ghost Story
programme.desc: At first time in her life Masha is frightened in earnest, however this creepy story shook up the whole forest and now hardly anyone can stay away from these strange scenes! And what would you do if your own pillow and blanket turn into real ghosts?! A real ghost story, oh yeah!

programme.title: The Very Fairy Tale
programme.desc: Masha loves fairy tales and of course she believes that each fairy tale should lead to happy end, even if nothing contributes to it! That's how the story goes… The Bear still hopes to win the heart of the female Bear. He finds an ancient gondola at the bottom of the forest lake. The Bear decides to restore it and invites the female Bear for a romantic ride! No one would have expected that this story would perfectly match Masha's new hobby - puppet theatre.

programme.title: Time To Ride My Pony
programme.desc: The Bear's good friend, the Tiger, is back for a visit and they decide to spend the time together in an intellectual way – playing chess. Masha is immediately drawn into the game and to everyone's surprise, she outsmarts and outplays both the Bear and his friend with just one chess figure.

programme.title: The Grand Piano Lesson
programme.desc: The bear finds a beautiful black piano in the forest. He happily takes it home, fixes and tunes it and begins to play some music. Masha couldn't help staying away from this lovely instrument. She decides to become a world famous pianist, she asks the Bear to teach her how to play the piano.

programme.title: Arts and Crafts Day
programme.desc: Masha announces Arts and Crafts Day. Get your glue, pencils and any unnecessary things and let's create! The Bear is trying to sneak away on a fishing trip. But what will he catch if all his floats are gone for crafts? Is it Masha, to put her in a corner? Well, not this time. Friendship always wins in our creative contests!

programme.title: The Foundling
programme.desc: Occasionally Masha finds an egg, from which a penguin hatches. The Bear has to take double care now. He cooks special dishes and builds mini aqua park for little penguin and Masha. Finally the Bear figures out that the penguin will be happy only in suitable weather conditions and send the penguin Antarctica on a little plane.

programme.title: See You Later
programme.desc: This day will change Bear's life forever. To everyone's surprise, Masha has suddenly grown up, getting all the forest dwellers shocked by her exceptionally good behavior. Her sister Dasha is going to take her back to the big city, which really upsets the Bear and others.

programme.title: Sleeping Beauties
programme.desc: Masha is the best "mommy" in the world, but even she can not put Rosy to sleep. Bear offers a solution: a music box. And everything would have been fine, but the music box suddenly turns out to hold a surprise inside it!

programme.title: We Come In Peace!
programme.desc: In the courtyard of the Bear's house a spaceship makes an emergency landing. The aliens need to urgently replenish their supplies and return home. The bug suffered a lot until he realized that all tiny things you see in the dark just seem to be frightful and fear makes no sense at all!

programme.desc: Masha narrates a terrific story about one little girl who was afraid of doctors. And once upon a time she experienced one fantastic story…she decided to cook dinner for her dolls. She took some clay and made “meat balls” with “semolina porridge”. As the meal seemed tasty, Sima decided to eat a bit of her dinner too… And so she lies in her bad and feels a horrible stomachache. Nobody knows how long she would need to suffer, but when she woke up…she realized herself in hospital…near the real snow queen… who explained that medical treatment is not scary at all…though some other things are very fearsome! Oh yeah!

programme.title: Bloodcurdling Saga About Joyful Event
programme.desc: Everyone think that it's so scary to be little as there are so many things are not accessible for you! But in reality there is no difference how little you are if there is someone who cares for you and someone you care about…

And how could you go out if you were born in the year of Purple rabbit that promises…no matter what… You'll see…

programme.title: Terrifying True Story About Monsters And Those Who Fear Them
programme.desc: Are you afraid of monsters? Sure you are! Let me tell you a scary story about a boy who experienced a real fear…This story happened on an abandoned tractor factory. The boy lost a scoop from his toy-tractor and decided to look for it at the factory. So he goes up the stairs and sees a large female monster, who was about to paint her lips with a roller! As he kept walking he noticed more monsters playing domino! The boy was very terrified and about to cry, when he learnt that it was just a movie set and all the monsters were not real! They were just actors…Finally the boy realized that all the monsters from the books and movies are not real at all! But if want to see a real monster- watch a fly under a microscope!

programme.title: The Wolf and the Fox
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: The Wolf and the Seven Young Kids
programme.desc: This educative tale teaches us that caution should never be dismissed. Mother-Goat goes to pick up cabbage, leaving her seven kids alone at home. Hungry Wolf tries to get into the house imitating mother Goat's voice to fool the little yeanlings. He manages to deceive six kids, but the seventh, the smallest one, manages to hide in the oven. The Wolf tries to get into the house through the chimney, but here comes Mother-Goat and finds her seventh kid. She melts the stove, and the Wolf rushes into the forest with his tail burnt. The other six kids come back home and finally the family reunites.

programme.title: The Fox and the Rolling Pin
programme.desc: This is the story about the Fox, the Cat and the Rooster. The sneaky Fox wanted to fool the Cat in order to eat the Rooster and get a rolling-pin. No matter how the Fox tried to butter up the Cat, he denied hand over the Rooster to the Fox. To teach her a lesson, the Cat got into a bag himself and when the Fox opened it in order to eat the Rooster, the Cat jumped out of it and frightened her. The point of the story is that “if you are well off you don't seek better”.

Despite Tsar's insidious plan, Yegor has successfully returned back home and even taught the king an important lesson not to envy other people.Once upon a time there was a king. He was very cranky and foolish.

programme.title: The Tribal Canvas (R)
programme.desc: The Tribal Canvas is a documentary series by Gurneet Kaur that explores the rich, living heritage of India's indigenous tribes. Each episode journeys into the heart of a different tribal community, capturing their traditions, rituals, art forms, belief systems, and way of life—told through their own voices. Blending immersive visuals with sensitive storytelling, The Tribal Canvas goes beyond documentation to reveal the soul of tribal India. The show highlights how these communities preserve centuries-old wisdom while adapting to a rapidly changing world. From music, dance, and craftsmanship to food, festivals, and daily life, every episode paints a vivid portrait of cultural identity and resilience.

programme.title: Indipedia
programme.desc: A light and peppy anchor driven half-hour episodic series that explores the reasons, bellefs and logic behind the customs and rituals observed as a norm In India, often so casually that most of us have never really asked why they arethe way they are.

programme.title: Sharanam
programme.desc: Sharanam takes viewers on a poignant journey to some of the most revered pilgrimage sites in India to and highlights the traditions, practices, rituals and ideals that bring people to these holy places in search of something greater than themselves. Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.title: Lost Recipes
programme.desc: Lost Recipes is all about the food which is diffused into the pages of history and the rediscovery of a tradition that once was. Our host Aditya Bal is on a quest to unearth the once-popular culinary traditions through thirteen regions in India.But these recipes are no longer found in cookbooks, old or new, and seem to have evolved with time. Aditya must turn back the clock and wade through folk and lore to find the original, Lost Recipes.

programme.title: Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: Safarnama
programme.desc: Safarnama is more than just a mere journey one wants to complete just to check out that one task from the ‘ToDo List”. It is something just one of its kind. In Safarnama, we are up for a soulfulfilling journey with Ankit Siwach that is to begin in Mumbai and cease at Ladakh. This journey is to witness numerous unseen moments and unfelt experiences via a thrilling, adventurous route. It isn't just about navigating roads using GPS but more of digging deeper into the beauty of India to understand life better.

programme.desc: Pork and the grill are good buddies and host Spencer Watts shows us four of his favourite pork recipes that will have you salivating.

programme.title: Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: Fun and quirky host Chef Spencer Watts kicks off this episode by showing off his knife skills as he sabres a pineapple to start his instant classic Grilled Fruit Salad. The pineapple joins a mix of bright summer fruits on the grill, then berries, spicy citrus vinaigrette and savoury feta cheese. Next up, Spencer whips up his Hawaiian Chicken recipe. Spiced with cayenne and Chinese five spice, Spencer stuffs flavourful chicken thighs with pineapple and grills it with a delightful ginger and soy sauce. Every bite is sweet, savoury, and fresh - exactly how summer should taste! Then Spencer shares his top tips for adding smoky flavours to pork using an easy and handy smoke pouch. His Apple Smoked Pork Tenderloin is bathed in a fog of applewood smoke and he then tops it with tart apple-blueberry compote. Cinnamon buns are amazing with a bit of orange peel - but have you ever had them in an orange peel and on the grill? That's right and Spencer shows you how you can make fun and flavourful Orange Peel Cinnamon Buns on the barbecue using indirect heat.

programme.title: Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: Onions, green onions, chives, garlic, and leeks are all members of the same fabulous flowering family, Allium! First up? Chef Watts shows us his sweet and smoky Charred Leeks with Romesco add grilled toast and you have your next party appetizer! Next up is a main course. Spencer starts with a juicy grilled pork chop, then adds roasted garlic melted into a balsamic onion chutney to make his out-of-this-world Roasted Garlic Pork Chops. Looking for a crowd pleaser that's easy to make? Spencer has a recipe for that! Chicken Yakitori. He threads skewers with crunchy green onions and tender chicken and caramelizes the yakitori sauce as he grills this tasty dish. Are you ready to drool? Spencer shows us how to make Allium your main dish with Stuffed Vidalia Onions. Loaded with savoury bacon, salty blue cheese and garlic, you'll want to eat this dish for every meal!

programme.title: Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: Have a cheese lover coming over? Blow their minds with some of Spencer's "grate" barbecued cheese recipes! First up, Spencer chars Brie Cheese to an ooey-gooey perfection and tops it with tart cherries and crunchy walnuts, serving it with crispy grilled crostinis. Next up is a Grilled Steak and Caesar with a twist only Spencer could add - grilled... lettuce! Then, Spencer uses the classic German "hasselback" presentation to stuff chicken breasts with verdant spinach, yummy Swiss cheese and pungent sun- dried tomatoes, grilling them to melty perfection. Finally, Spencer fires up his barbecue to make his Grilled Peaches with Salted Bourbon Caramel, a decadent dessert elevated with creamy Mascarpone and perfectly balances sweet, smoky, and salty flavours.

programme.title: Kia Sportage Exterior Design in Lunar Silver
programme.desc: A number of new technologies optimize the precision and control of the chassis in a wide variety of weather and road conditions. The standard electronic damper control (Electronic Control Suspension, ECS) in the GT-line version increases comfort and safety thanks to the continuous damping control. The system reacts to body movements and steering inputs and changes the damping behavior at lightning speed in order to counteract the vehicle's diving, pitching and rolling movements when cornering. It also adjusts the damping force in the case of obstacles in order to cope with them as comfortably as possible and to reduce the influence of post-vibrations on the wheels. A premiere for the Sportage is the “All-Terrain-Mode”, which will be available for the plug-in hybrid version with all-wheel drive. The system offers intelligent support when driving off-road or on snow by automatically optimizing the vehicle settings depending on the selected mode and thus helping the SUV to achieve maximum traction on muddy, sandy or snowy surfaces.

Wheel arch liners in the vehicle colour are available from the AMG Line upwards for the first time. programme.desc: With the luxury saloon EQS and the sporty executive saloon EQE, Mercedes-Benz has entered a new, all-electric era in the upper market segments as well. The EQS SUV, the third model series with this architecture developed for electric vehicles, will soon follow. The SUV offers plenty of space, comfort and connectivity for up to seven passengers in its avant-garde, luxurious interior. Thanks to powerful electric motors, responsive 4MATIC all-wheel drive and an intelligent OFFROAD driving mode, the EQS SUV is also capable of tackling light terrain with ease. The new EQS SUV shares the long wheelbase (3210 millimetres) with the EQS Saloon, but is over 20 centimetres higher. The dimensions in detail: 5125/1959/1718 millimetres (length/width/height). The interior dimensions benefit from these generous SUV dimensions and from the advantages of the purpose design tailored to the electric platform. The second row of seats can be electrically adjusted as standard. Up to four golf bags fit in the boot. A third row of seats with two additional individual seats and extensive comfort features for all passengers is available as an option.

programme.title: Colour change with the power of thought
programme.sub-title: The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology
programme.desc: The Munich-based startup brainboost used the new and improved colour-changing effect in a one-off collaboration with the BMW Group at rad°hub aimed at raising awareness of mental health. With the help of brainboost, the BMW iX Flow was connected directly to the brain of the rad°hub delegates using an electroencephalograph (EEG), which records the brain's electrical activity. “The colour patterns of the BMW iX Flow react to brain activity and reflect the level of activity,” explains brainboost CEO Philipp Heiler. “Once the brain is at rest, the changes of patterns on the iX Flow also become calmer and more rhythmical.” A special animation was activated if delegates managed to maintain this state for several seconds. Thus, the participants were able to gradually calm and relax their brains under the guidance of the brainboost experts and with the help of neurofeedback via the iX Flow. This matures the knowledge of which strategies work best to specifically shut down one's own brain activity for relaxation, e.g. in everyday working life.

programme.desc: To celebrate the arrival of the new Bentayga EWB, an exclusive First Edition is now available. Subject to a limited production run for the first twelve months of orders, it combines many of the most desirable options available for the car with a package of eye-catching details found only on Bentley First Editions. First Edition badging can be seen to the exterior of the car – a theme that extends inside, with badging on the veneered fascia, as well as embroidery on the seats. programme.title: From concept vehicle to full-production ID. Buzz
programme.sub-title: How was the electric Microbus created
programme.desc: The new model line's assistance systems perfect ease of driving and safety. Included as standard in the ID. Buzz and ID. Buzz Cargo is the ‘Car2X' local warning system, which utilises signals from other vehicles and the transport infrastructure to spot hazards in real time. Also included as standard: the ‘Front Assist' emergency braking function and, in the MPV, the ‘Lane Assist' lane-keeping assistant. With new software, new assistance functions are also making their way into the ID. family. Available as an option is ‘Travel Assist with swarm data', which facilitates partially automated driving across the entire speed range and, for the first time, assisted lane-changing on the motorway. programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.
